Name: Hamor
Summary: Hamor was a Hivite prince, the father of Shechem, who tried to arrange a marriage alliance with Jacob's family.
KeyStory: After his son wronged Dinah, Hamor negotiated for intermarriage — but Simeon and Levi used the negotiations to destroy his city.
RelatedPeople: Shechem, Son of Hamor; Dinah; Jacob; Simeon, Son of Jacob; Levi
LifeLesson: Negotiation without repentance cannot undo a wrong.
